hints.title: Root Location and Boundary Obstacle
hints.text: The first element of preorder is always the root, but where do its left and right children end? How can locating the root value within the inorder traversal partition elements into left and right subtrees?

hints.title: Inorder Subtree Partition Invariant
hints.text: The inorder traversal positions all left subtree values to the left of the root and all right subtree values to the right, dictating subtree sizes.

hints.title: Recursive Range Splitting Procedure
hints.text: Build an index map of value to position in inorder. Maintain an index pointer in preorder. Recursively construct the tree for inorder range [left, right]: pick the current root from preorder, split the inorder range at the root index, and recurse for left and right child ranges.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Hash map lookup provides O(1) partition indexing, constructing the tree in linear total time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Using list.index() in every recursive call takes O(N^2) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(N) memory for the hash map to achieve O(N) runtime.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Using an index map to avoid quadratic slicing or linear searches.
